guarantees.claim: When sel_mux is MuxFifo, keccak_data_o is assigned msg_data_i.
When sel_mux is MuxPrefix, keccak_data_o is assigned prefix_data.
When sel_mux is MuxFuncPad, keccak_data_o is assigned funcpad_data.
When sel_mux is MuxZeroEnd, keccak_data_o is assigned zero_with_endbit.
When sel_mux is any other value (including X or Z), keccak_data_o is driven to all zeros.
guarantees.cond: sel_mux not equal to MuxFifo, MuxPrefix, MuxFuncPad, MuxZeroEnd

assumptions.claim: sel_mux must be restricted to the four defined enum values MuxFifo, MuxPrefix, MuxFuncPad, MuxZeroEnd during normal operation; any other encoding or X/Z is illegal.
assumptions.cond: whenever the mux drives valid data
assumptions.risk: If sel_mux takes an illegal value, the default assignment forces keccak_data_o to all zeros, which downstream keccak logic may treat as legitimate input, silently corrupting the SHA3 padding and resulting digest.

assumptions.claim: The data input selected by sel_mux (msg_data_i, prefix_data, funcpad_data, or zero_with_endbit) must remain stable and glitch-free while sel_mux is in the corresponding state.
assumptions.cond: when sel_mux is stable in a given state
assumptions.risk: Combinational mux glitches could propagate to keccak_data_o and be incorrectly sampled by downstream logic, leading to data corruption.

uncertain_points.claim: The default case comment labels it as 'MuxNone', but there is no explicit MuxNone case item. If MuxNone is a legal sel_mux encoding, it will fall into the default and incorrectly output all zeros.
uncertain_points.cond: if MuxNone is a defined and reachable sel_mux value
uncertain_points.risk: The keccak padding block may produce invalid data during MuxNone cycles, corrupting the SHA3 digest and breaking integrity guarantees.

uncertain_points.claim: The source logic that drives sel_mux must be verified to never produce values outside {MuxFifo, MuxPrefix, MuxFuncPad, MuxZeroEnd} during operation; otherwise the default all-zero output can silently corrupt padding.
uncertain_points.cond: when sel_mux is controlled by external logic
uncertain_points.risk: Silent keccak data corruption leading to wrong hash digest, a security‑relevant functional fault.
